title: Remote access: tools, consent and logging

videos.script: Most support happens at a distance. You connect to the user's computer and see their screen, or run commands on it, without walking over. {{distance}} It is fast, and it is also someone else's computer, with their mail, their files and their open windows on it. So two things matter as much as the tool: consent, and a record. {{two}} This lesson goes through the tools you will meet, then shows consent working on a real session: refused, allowed, watch only, ended, each step taken by the user. {{steps}} And it looks at what the computer writes down about you while you are there. {{record}}
